query:
SELECT
                users.id as "id!",
                users.name,
                users.discord_id,
                users.cash_balance,
                source as "source!: TransferSource",
                direction as "direction!: TransferDirection",
                SUM(amount) as "amount!"
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    receiver AS user_id,
                    source,
                    amount,
                    'credit' as direction
                FROM transfers
                UNION ALL
                SELECT
                    sender AS user_id,
                    source,
                    -amount as amount,
                    'debit' as direction
                FROM transfers
            ) t
            JOIN users ON users.id = t.user_id
            GROUP BY users.id, source, direction
            ORDER BY users.id, source, direction
